At PTSMC, we are dedicated to improving the quality of people's lives by providing unmatched experiences, clinical excellence and lifelong relationships. Part of that service includes teaching our patients and the general public the importance of taking care of your body. This channel was started with the aim to offer advice, tips and guidance from our expert clinicians to help you prevent and care for aches, pains and injuries so you have the tools and knowledge to take care of yourself every day! 

With 30+ locations around Connecticut and Massachusetts, PTSMC is the state's largest private outpatient physical therapy company. You can learn more about PTSMC and find out about our locations, staff and treatment options at www.ptsmc.com.
